text: I feel curious and contemplative in this place. The modern, geometric glass walls and abundance of technology create an atmosphere humming with the promise of discovery. The exhibit on research and development invites me to ponder the nature of innovation and human progress. I sense that I am a participant in a space that values inquiry—a laboratory of both thought and form—where questions are as important as answers. There is a quiet anticipation in the air, as if new knowledge waits just around the corner.
